summary: Defined PID 1 runtime recovery drills for AgentOS, covering read-only, write-with-diff, approval-pending, activation-pending, degraded-dependency and QEMU boot smoke scenarios.
acceptance_evidence: runtime-recovery-drills.md defines drill scenarios for read-only unsealed effects, write-with-diff unsealed effects, approval pending, approval denied, activation pending, degraded dependency and QEMU boot smoke.
The drill taxonomy maps each simulated interruption to expected recovery state and evidence source.
Local-only fixture drills are defined without external LLM, remote registry, network or host package manager.
QEMU drill documents the required markers and the E:\qemu\qemu-system-x86_64.exe path.
boot-smoke-result.json observed AGENTD_HANDOFF_OK, AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ARTIFACTS_OK and runtime manifest marker within 30 seconds.

commands.summary: agent_core 94 passed; agentd 56 passed; runtime_contracts 9 passed; security_execution 75 passed; doc tests passed.

blocked_shortcuts: No recovery drill depends on external LLM.
No pending approval is auto-approved after restart.
No half-committed write or activation is silently completed.
No missing optional dependency falls back to unsafe host mutation.
No support bundle evidence may include raw secrets.
promotion_impact: Closes Wave 2 by defining local and QEMU recovery drills that prove AgentOS can recover PID 1 runtime state with durable evidence.
